headline: Is The Market Underpricing Airbnb Stock?

headline: Jefferies Maintains Coca-Cola Buy Rating as KFC Switches US Beverage Supply From PepsiCo
summary: Jefferies has maintained its Buy rating on Coca-Cola (NYSE:KO) and Hold rating on PepsiCo (NASDAQ:PEP) following KFC’s decision to replace Pepsi with Coca-Cola as its beverage supplier in the United States. The investment bank described the change as unexpected, particularly as it follows Marriott’s decision several months earlier to move to Coca-Cola after maintaining a relationship with Pepsi for approximately 30 years.
